serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Was that… my phone? I got a text. 
Let me check that really quick… No way… It’s my ex.
M-maybe she wants to get back to me. Our break up wasn’t that bad, for her at least. 
She dumped me for some Jerome guy only because I was broke at the time. How selfish can one person get? 
It’s not my fault that all of these employers didn’t see my true potential. 
Whatever, I’m not gonna delay it any longer and just read it. 
@‘Hi there Anon :) What are you up to? I told you that I still want to be friends with you so you can text me anytime you want <3 Your mom told me she is worried about you! Don’t scare miss Charlotte, be better than that! BTW I’m doing great! Me and hun are leaving tomorrow for our trip! Hope you answer soon :) Much love <3’
Mom wtf!
Geez, she really screwed me up right now. How the hell did she even contact her! They exchanged contact info? When?! 
But man, the nerve of this girl! She just had to tell me she is doing better than me. What a bitch. I do not CARE about your road trip and I don’t NEED your pity. 
This whole ‘friendship’ stuff. Hehe. Are you kidding me? Does anyone in his right mind believe shit like that? 
She left me for another dude, there is no way we are going to be all buddy buddy with each other.
Anyway, I’m not gonna answer. She can rot for all I care.
This fucking ruined my day.
